in_marathi.name: Gurudutt
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Learner of the Truth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gurudutt हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Gurudutt is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Guru’ meaning ‘teacher’ and ‘Dutt’ meaning ‘servant’ or ‘learner’. This name signifies one who is a devoted learner, especially of spiritual truths. In Hindu mythology, the term ‘Guru’ is used to denote a spiritual teacher or guide who imparts wisdom and knowledge to his students.
